Chapter 220: Chapter 15: Breakthrough To The Sixth Rank (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 220: Chapter 15: Breakthrough to the Sixth Rank (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chikun Star Lord himself found it somewhat incredible. He had presided over the Chikun Star Domain for nearly two hundred thousand years and had initiated the Seven Star Cave challenges countless times.

Yet, he had never seen an evolver with talents and qualities like Lin Yuan.

In the past, Chikun Star Lord had only heard rumors about such talented evolvers, but this time, he unexpectedly became his disciple.

“Really not even a hundred years old?” the man in the white robe gasped, “My disciple lost honorably.”

The man in the white robe thought of the junior disciple who had been utterly defeated by Lin Yuan recently.

“Truly a monster.”

...

The man in the white robe couldn’t help but say.

“No need to say that. Once he steps into the Sixth Rank, there will be even more challenges waiting for him. Our human civilization initially proceeds smoothly, showing terrifying potentials, but there are also evolvers who fail to advance beyond the Sixth or Seventh Rank.”

Chikun Star Lord shook his head, “Don’t set too high expectations for Shisan. The higher you stand, the harder you fall.”

“Still pretending at this time?”

The man in the white robe rolled his eyes. Although the words were right, they somehow tasted bitter to him.

“How about I trade one hundred disciples for this one of yours?” the man in the white robe said.

“No deal.” Chikun Star Lord didn’t even think about it, “It’s your move.”

…

Several days later.

Central Continent Manor.

Lin Yuan, having finished his last match, came outside the manor.

“Mr. Lin, here are your items…” A man in a black uniform stood outside the manor, behind him stood a several-meter-tall box.

Drip—

Following identity authorization.

Lin Yuan asked the housekeeper robot to move the box to the underground training facility in the main building.

While passing the grassy field, Lin Yuan saw his parents chatting with Lin Yi, his sister.

“Mom, Dad, you have no idea how formidable Peak Master Shisan is. With just a couple of slaps, he shattered Wanyang Holy Son, Wanyang Holy Son, you know, is considered the undisputed number one below the Sixth Rank in the Wanyang Star Domain…”

Lin Yi was vividly enlightening her parents with the glorious feats of Peak Master Shisan.

“Incredible.”

“Peak Master Shisan is indeed formidable.”

The parents continually nodded. Without Lin Yi’s explanations, they too had entered the virtual world recently and heard most about this.

“I just wonder when our Canglan Star will produce a figure like Peak Master Shisan.”

Mother Lu Qiong sighed.

“Mom, what are you dreaming about? That’s Peak Master Shisan. In the Chikun Star Domain, with more than a million life planets, only such one exists. It’s already lucky enough for Canglan Star to have my brother. A Peak Master Shisan? Absolutely impossible.”

Lin Yi shook her head, explaining to Lu Qiong.

Even though Lu Qiong was also an evolver, she didn’t understand much about the evolver community and just knew that Peak Master Shisan was formidable.

But how formidable, she wasn’t aware, thus she idly fantasized if Canglan Star could also produce an evolver like him.

Lin Yi felt like laughing internally.

In such a shallow pool as Canglan Star, dreaming of producing a true dragon like Peak Master Shisan?

…

Underground training facility in the main building.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, looking at the box in front of him.

In the box was exactly what Lin Yuan had applied for—’Scarlet Spirit Liquid’.

To ensure a smooth breakthrough to the Sixth Rank, Lin Yuan had requested “a large basin” of Scarlet Spirit Liquid this time.

“It’s time to make a breakthrough.”

Lin Yuan steadied his mind, having made his decision.

The inner conditions, a hundred percent soul-bonding transformation, were met.

The external conditions, ‘a large basin’ of Scarlet Spirit Liquid, satisfied all consumption during the breakthrough period.

“Hou Ming.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and called Hou Ming, the captain of the guard troops.

“For the coming period until I emerge, no matter what happens, do not let anyone come near.”

Lin Yuan stated.

“Yes.”

Captain Hou Ming spoke reverently.

…

Lin Yuan returned to the underground training facility again.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan looked at ‘a large basin’ of Scarlet Spirit Liquid in front of him and took a gentle breath.

A massive amount of Scarlet Spirit Liquid evaporated into the air, merging into Lin Yuan’s body.

With the influx of huge, pure energy, Lin Yuan started to release control over his physical soul.

Rustle, rustle.

The amount of Scarlet Spirit Liquid visibly reduced.

While Lin Yuan’s physical soul quickly began to grow stronger.

Why are Sixth Rank evolvers called Fallen Star Level? It’s because their physical souls become powerfully unimaginable. With each breath, they absorb and exhale the cosmic energies, neutralizing various stellar radiations without depending on the planetary environment.

For a Sixth Rank evolver, medium to low-grade life planets are already restrictive, akin to a shark trapped in a small pond.

The battleground for Sixth Rank evolvers lies in the cosmos.

Hum, hum, hum.

As Lin Yuan’s physical soul continued to transform and ascend, it gradually began to affect the surroundings, forming a unique life magnetic field characteristic of Sixth Rank evolvers.

Of course, ordinary evolvers can’t perceive this influence, and even Fourth and Fifth Rank evolvers cannot sense it.

Only—

“Hm?”

“Is my junior brother starting his breakthrough?”

The bald man was strolling slowly, sensing something, and immediately glanced towards the Central Mainland.

“To protect my junior brother.”

The bald man’s figure vanished, instantly appearing at the edge of the Central Mainland.

“Although it’s unlikely, if a group of Seventh Rank alien species were to attack now, I could completely block them to buy time for my junior brother’s breakthrough.”

“If Eighth Rank aliens were to attack, I would also have enough time to take my junior brother and run.”

The bald man thought covertly.

Logically speaking, the alien species should not be aware of Lin Yuan’s true identity yet, otherwise, they would have sent strong entities to kill him long ago.

…

On the other side of Canglan Star.

A member of the Demonic Mouse Race, only one meter fifty tall, lay on the bed.
